data.title: La Mazzoni
data.about:
La Mazonni by The Luxe Developers on Al Marjan Island introduces 562 units, including 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments, chalets, duplexes, and penthouses designed for luxurious coastal living. Located in Ras Al Khaimah, this stunning development offers an easy payment plan, settled quarterly in 14 payments. Strategically situated on Al Marjan Island, it provides unparalleled access to amenities and breathtaking natural surroundings.

The master plan embodies luxury with a library, connoisseur's corner, tranquility temple, and paddle courts. With proximity to key attractions such as Wynn Resorts, Royal Yacht Club, and Al Hamra Golf Club, La Mazonni offers a seamless blend of luxury and convenience.

Elevate your lifestyle with La Mazonni’s unmatched amenities and prime location. Discover the perfect balance of sophistication and serenity in a community designed to inspire. Whether for residence or investment, La Mazonni Apartments redefine luxury real estate in Ras Al Khaimah. Don’t miss the chance to live where extraordinary moments await daily.

characteristics_module.title: La Mazonni on Al Marjan Island - Minutes from Everything, Miles Beyond Ordinary
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Prime Location: Situated on Al Marjan Island, Ras Al Khaimah, offering a harmonious blend of luxury and natural beauty.
  • Easy connectivity to top destinations like Wynn Resort, Royal Yacht Club, Al Hamra Al Hamra Golf Club, RAK Central, and easy access to three airports Dubai, RAK, and Sharjah.
  • Luxury Living Spaces: Offers a range of 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments, chalets, duplexes, and penthouses with private pools.
  • World-Class Amenities: The complex includes a sky lounge, kid’s play area, tranquility temple, paddle court, library, and co-working spaces.
  • Thoughtfully Designed Master Plan: Combines waterfront elegance and modern architecture inspired by the sea and natural surroundings.
  • Flexible Payment Plan: A 70/30 split, payable quarterly across 14 installments, ensuring convenience and affordability.
  • Landmark Destination: Set amidst Al Marjan Island’s natural splendor, close to luxury hubs and surrounded by serene landscapes.

location_tile.title: Where Waterfront Living Meets Unmatched Connectivity and World-Class Attractions.
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
Al Marjan Island, the jewel of Ras Al Khaimah, is home to La Mazonni’s luxurious apartments. Just 60 minutes from Dubai Airport and 30 minutes from RAK Airport, it ensures unparalleled connectivity. Surrounded by world-class attractions like Wynn Resort and Al Hamra Golf Club, the location blends leisure and elegance. La Mazonni on Al Marjan Island redefines beachfront living, offering a perfect balance of nature, luxury, and sophistication for discerning buyers.

  • 04 minutes to Wynn Resort
  • 08 minutes to Al Hamra Mall
  • 09 minutes to RAK Central
  • 10 minutes to Al Hamra Golf Club
  • 12 minutes to Royal Yacht Club
  • 30 minutes to RAK Airport
  • 45 minutes to Sharjah Airport
  • 60 minutes to Dubai Airport

seo.metaTitle: La Mazonni on Al Marjan Island Ras Al Khaimah
seo.metaDescription: Discover La Mazonni on Al Marjan Island, which offers 1-3 bedroom apartments, penthouses, and chalets—luxurious living with stunning views and world-class amenities.

more_info.answer: All units provide exceptional views of the Wynn Casino, the sea, and the vibrant downtown.
more_info.question: What views do La Mazonni units offer?

more_info.answer:
La Mazonni offers a range of fully furnished units with stunning views:

• 1-bedroom: AED 1.8M, 850-1150 sq. ft.
• 2-bedroom: AED 3.1M, 1200-1600 sq. ft.
• 3-bedroom: AED 4.7M, 1750-3000 sq. ft.
• Penthouses (with private pools): AED 21.5M, 6000-7500 sq. ft.
• Chalets (podium villas): AED 10.5M, 4000-5000 sq. ft.
more_info.question: What types of units are available at La Mazonni, and what are their prices and sizes?

more_info.answer:
La Mazonni offers a luxurious lifestyle with amenities including:

• Rooftop pool, cigar lounge, spa, and hammam.
• Greenery Zen lifestyle, waterfront seating, and cascading water features.
• Fitness facilities, tennis and paddle courts, jogging trails, and a gym.
• Social garden, amphitheater, kids’ play areas, and co-working spaces
more_info.question: What amenities are available at La Mazonni on Al Marjan Island?

more_info.answer:
The project offers a 70/30 payment plan:
• 5% booking fee, 15% down payment (within one month).
• 3% each quarter (1% per month, totaling 12% annually).
• 30% on handover in Q4 2028.
more_info.question: What is the payment plan for La Mazonni, and when is the handover?

more_info.answer: Yes! Expressions of interest (EOIs) are being collected with a 5% discount on the prices. Take advantage of this early-buyer opportunity!
